fullText.simplified:
第30章、计划

    李河太难过了，他等了一会儿，才继续说：“一年前，你先生回来了，你没有时间写小说了，所以作家春草不见了。如果没有你先生，你的故事就结束了。后来发生的这些事，都是因为你不爱你先生了。我不知道你为什么不爱他了，是因为他太老、样子不好看了吗？还是因为他在床上打你？去年九月的那个大新闻——男人在床上把爱人打死了，你看到了，对吗？虽然你先生打你也是因为太爱你，但你还是害怕了，对吗？你想离开他，但是你没有钱，离开他后你没有钱生活，所以你想到杀了他。他死以后，你就可以拿着他的钱，开心地生活了，对吗？
    你很聪明，以前我觉得侦探小说家写的故事像小孩子的游戏，是我错了。你是一位非常优秀的侦探小说家，你的计划没有任何缺点。春草给我的信是你写的，你约我在咖啡馆见面，我一点儿都没有怀疑，从那时候开始，我就掉进了你的计划。张一南写给你的信，也是你自己写的，今年你在出租车司机那儿看到了你先生的笔，后来你在家里找到了那支笔的笔帽。你爬到天花板上，把笔帽放在那儿，还故意让我发现。你这样做的目的，就是为了让我相信张一南真的要杀你和你先生。”
    李河有点儿累了，他看着高静，问：“还要我继续说吗？”
    高静哭了，她大声说：“不，你不要说了，真的不要说了。”
    李河说：“好，那我不说了，你自己来说后面发生的事，好不好？”
    “你为什么要这样？我很喜欢你，你不知道吗？”高静抱住李河，激动地说：“我真的很喜欢你啊！你不喜欢我吗？”
    李河难过极了，他低头看着高静，说：“你不要这样，没有用的。”
fullText.traditional:
第30章、計劃

    李河太難過了，他等了一會兒，才繼續說：“一年前，你先生回來了，你沒有時間寫小說了，所以作家春草不見了。如果沒有你先生，你的故事就結束了。後來發生的這些事，都是因為你不愛你先生了。我不知道你為什麼不愛他了，是因為他太老、樣子不好看了嗎？還是因為他在床上打你？去年九月的那個大新聞——男人在床上把愛人打死了，你看到了，對嗎？雖然你先生打你也是因為太愛你，但你還是害怕了，對嗎？你想離開他，但是你沒有錢，離開他後你沒有錢生活，所以你想到殺了他。他死以後，你就可以拿著他的錢，開心地生活了，對嗎？
    你很聰明，以前我覺得偵探小說家寫的故事像小孩子的遊戲，是我錯了。你是一位非常優秀的偵探小說家，你的計劃沒有任何缺點。春草給我的信是你寫的，你約我在咖啡館見面，我一點兒都沒有懷疑，從那時候開始，我就掉進了你的計劃。張一南寫給你的信，也是你自己寫的，今年你在出租車司機那兒看到了你先生的筆，後來你在家裡找到了那支筆的筆帽。你爬到天花板上，把筆帽放在那兒，還故意讓我發現。你這樣做的目的，就是為了讓我相信張一南真的要殺你和你先生。”
    李河有點兒累了，他看著高靜，問：“還要我繼續說嗎？”
    高靜哭了，她大聲說：“不，你不要說了，真的不要說了。”
    李河說：“好，那我不說了，你自己來說後面發生的事，好不好？”
    “你為什麼要這樣？我很喜歡你，你不知道嗎？”高靜抱住李河，激動地說：“我真的很喜歡你啊！你不喜歡我嗎？”
    李河難過極了，他低頭看著高靜，說：“你不要這樣，沒有用的。”

sentences.english: I don’t know why you don’t love him anymore. Is it because he’s too old and is no longer attractive?

sentences.simplified: 还是因为他在床上打你？
sentences.traditional: 還是因為他在床上打你？

sentences.english: Or is it because he hits you in bed?

sentences.english: Last September’s big news—a man hit his wife to death in bed, you saw that, didn’t you?

sentences.english: Even though your husband hit you, it was also because he loved you too much. But you were still scared, right?

sentences.english: You wanted to leave him, but you didn’t have any money. If you left him, you wouldn’t have any money to live, so you wanted to kill him.

sentences.simplified: 他死以后，你就可以拿着他的钱，开心地生活了，对吗？

sentences.english: After he died, you could take his money and live happily, right?

sentences.english: You are very smart. I used to think that the stories detective novelists wrote were like children’s games, but I was wrong.

sentences.simplified: 你是一位非常优秀的侦探小说家，你的计划没有任何缺点。

sentences.english: You are an extremely talented detective novelist. Your plan did not have any shortcomings.

sentences.english: The letters that Chun Cao sent to me were written by you. You invited me to meet at the cafe, and I didn’t suspect anything at all.

sentences.simplified: 从那时候开始，我就掉进了你的计划。

sentences.english: From that time onwards, I had fallen into your plan.

sentences.simplified: 张一南写给你的信，也是你自己写的，

sentences.traditional: 今年你在出租車司機那兒看到了你先生的筆，後來你在家裡找到了那支筆的筆帽。

sentences.traditional: 你這樣做的目的，就是為了讓我相信張一南真的要殺你和你先生。”

sentences.english: Your purpose for doing this was to make me believe that Zhang Yinan really wanted to kill you and your husband.”

sentences.english: Li He was quite tired. He looked at Gao Jing and asked, “Do you still need me to continue?”

sentences.simplified: 高静哭了，她大声说：“不，你不要说了，真的不要说了。”
sentences.traditional: 高靜哭了，她大聲說：“不，你不要說了，真的不要說了。”

sentences.english: Gao Jing cried and said loudly, “Don’t. Don’t say anything more. Really, don’t say anything more.”

sentences.traditional: 李河說：“好，那我不說了，你自己來說後面發生的事，好不好？”

sentences.english: Li He said, “Okay, then I won’t say anything more. You can say what happened afterward yourself, okay?”

sentences.simplified: “你为什么要这样？我很喜欢你，你不知道吗？”
sentences.traditional: “你為什麼要這樣？我很喜歡你，你不知道嗎？”

sentences.english: “Why are you doing this? I really like you. Don’t you know?”

sentences.traditional: 高靜抱住李河，激動地說：“我真的很喜歡你啊！你不喜歡我嗎？”

sentences.english: Gao Jing hugged Li He and said emotionally, “I really like you a lot! Don’t you like me?”

sentences.traditional: 李河難過極了，他低頭看著高靜，說：“你不要這樣，沒有用的。”

sentences.english: Li He was very sad. He lowered his head and looked at Gao Jing, saying, “Don’t be like this. It’s useless.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 30: The Plan
Li He was too upset. He waited a while before continuing:
“One year ago, your husband returned. You didn’t have time to write novels anymore, so the author Chun Cao disappeared.
If it weren’t for your husband, your story would have finished.
The events that happened afterward were all because you don’t love your husband anymore.
I don’t know why you don’t love him anymore. Is it because he’s too old and is no longer attractive?
Or is it because he hits you in bed?
Last September’s big news—a man hit his wife to death in bed, you saw that, didn’t you?
Even though your husband hit you, it was also because he loved you too much. But you were still scared, right?
You wanted to leave him, but you didn’t have any money. If you left him, you wouldn’t have any money to live, so you wanted to kill him.
After he died, you could take his money and live happily, right?
You are very smart. I used to think that the stories detective novelists wrote were like children’s games, but I was wrong.
You are an extremely talented detective novelist. Your plan did not have any shortcomings.
The letters that Chun Cao sent to me were written by you. You invited me to meet at the cafe, and I didn’t suspect anything at all.
From that time onwards, I had fallen into your plan.
The letters that Zhang Yinan wrote to you, you also wrote them yourself.
This year you saw your husband’s pen with the taxi driver, and later on, you found its pen cap at home.
You climbed into the ceiling and put the pen cap there. You also deliberately let me find it.
Your purpose for doing this was to make me believe that Zhang Yinan really wanted to kill you and your husband.”
Li He was quite tired. He looked at Gao Jing and asked, “Do you still need me to continue?”
Gao Jing cried and said loudly, “Don’t. Don’t say anything more. Really, don’t say anything more.”
Li He said, “Okay, then I won’t say anything more. You can say what happened afterward yourself, okay?”
“Why are you doing this? I really like you. Don’t you know?”
Gao Jing hugged Li He and said emotionally, “I really like you a lot! Don’t you like me?”
Li He was very sad. He lowered his head and looked at Gao Jing, saying, “Don’t be like this. It’s useless.”
